sheets.license:
Rig parts for fiara, cut with tools/rig-assist/cut.py --no-sam (hand-drawn polygons), then re-split for translucency.

Source sprite: public/assets/img/map/fiara.png, frame col 0, row 0, crop 0,0,80,80 (the legacy rest frame, facing east).
Source sprite provenance and licence: legacy Taming the Elements game art (Crafty.js version, git tag legacy-crafty-1.0),
  owned by the project owner. Licence: TO BE CONFIRMED BY THE OWNER before these parts are committed (the project licence is
  still "to be decided" in README.md).
Edits: parts cut and underlap-filled automatically (edge-extend colour). Because the sprite is translucent (alpha about 76 %),
  the underlap alpha was feathered (ramped down with distance from the seam, capped below the covering pixel's alpha) and the
  covering pixels re-solved so the rest pose composites back to the legacy frame within 1/255. SE and NE part variants are the
  E parts rotated 8 degrees (premultiplied bicubic) with the back wing narrowed to 90 %. No hand retouching.
  Done by Claude (WP5 Fiara vertical slice, 2026-11-11) for owner review.
Licence of these parts: same as the source sprite.
Segmentation model: none (--no-sam; the masks are hand-drawn polygons).

Rig parts for pax: original art generated procedurally by this repository's tooling session (a Python, numpy and Pillow
scratch script written for WP-rig-pax, 2026-11-11, by Claude; the script is committed as tools/assets/rig-gen/pax.py). No pixels are copied from any other artwork.

Reference: the colours (grey-brown stone, olive-grey belly and legs, tan spikes) and the hunched, spiked silhouette were chosen by eye
to match the legacy Pax sprite (public/assets/img/map/pax.png, legacy Taming the Elements game art owned by the project owner), so
the hero stays recognisable. The legacy image itself is not used as a source of pixels.
Method: filled polygons per body part, supersampled 4x with value-noise shading, a darker rim and ridge lines, then downsampled to 1x.
SE and NE variants are the same shapes with per-view shifts and scales (head lower and larger for SE, smaller and with taller back
spikes for NE). No hand retouching.
Licence of these parts: generated by this repository's tooling; the same licence as the rest of the repository's original code and art
(still "to be decided" in README.md; owner to confirm).

Rig parts for treenoc: original art generated by tools/assets/rig-gen/treenoc.py (WP-rig-treenoc, 2026-11-11, Claude). No pixels
are copied; colours and silhouette chosen by eye after the legacy public/assets/img/map/treenoc.png. Licence: same as the
repository's own original code and art (still to be decided in README.md; owner to confirm).
